text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Manhattan Cafe—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following Manhattan Cafe's gaze, I saw a crane game filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Shall I get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Are you sure...? Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Besides... with that adorable plushie...
her hair... probably won't grow on its own...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... that's in the past...
More importantly... please do your best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
